checkpoint_rule: A dependency on a user checkpoint requires its explicit current digest-bound decision. No successor is released by elapsed time or a successful test.
future_scope_rule: Future marketplace contract work may be selected independently; dependency readiness is not implementation authorization.
construction_rule: Every materially revised future capability repeats CAV2-D65 prototype and test stages; coarse roadmap nodes are not permission to skip those stages.
artifact_path_base: browser-world; evidence paths are proposed future outputs, not existing evidence

nodes.title: Define browser journeys and observable state
nodes.done_when: Recorded observation, inspection, replay and discovery are bounded; fixture claims and exclusions are explicit.

nodes.title: Map local browser terms to exact source fields
nodes.done_when: Each local term points to selected evidence; no ontology admission is inferred.

nodes.title: Map product and implementation prototypes
nodes.done_when: Product, business, typed intent, compiled-system and implementation boundaries have source-linked prototype mappings.

nodes.title: Specify session and presentation contracts
nodes.done_when: Input bounds, identities, frame-index cursor, catalog association and recovery cases are testable.

nodes.title: Verify local build and browser environment
nodes.done_when: Actual Node/package paths, disk/cache location and browser/GPU evidence are recorded; unknown hardware is not called a pass.

nodes.title: Create locked browser package and engine lifecycle
nodes.done_when: Application builds; one engine mounts, resizes and disposes cleanly.

nodes.title: Optimize and refine colony assets
nodes.done_when: Derivative source mapping, transfer/GPU budgets and actual scene comparison preserve the requested art quality.

nodes.title: Implement validated session loading and playback
nodes.done_when: All 82 fixture frames survive including both tick-80 revisions; input failures and scrub invariants are verified.

nodes.title: Assemble colony and robot interactions
nodes.done_when: Real browser scene renders prepared assets with recorded motion, camera controls and stable robot selection.

nodes.title: Prepare verified loopback preview
nodes.done_when: Build/start commands and a reachable loopback URL are recorded without public publication.

nodes.title: Verify and capture the rendered world
nodes.done_when: Actual render, negative input checks, movement, fidelity comparison, resource lifecycle, transfer size and named-device frame timings have current evidence.

nodes.title: Review browser world visuals
nodes.done_when: User explicitly validates the exact rendered-scene candidate or requests a new B1 revision.
nodes.decision_rule: Explicit user decision on the exact candidate manifest; silence is not approval; changed candidate requires current evidence and a new decision.

nodes.title: Complete interface and capability views
nodes.done_when: Crew, inspector, replay, metadata facets and all interaction/recovery states use actual source values.

nodes.title: Verify complete browser interactions
